bio: Enjoy a delightful afternoon tea with exceptional service in a chic yet welcoming setting, with bubbling fountains and the sounds of a baby grand piano to create the perfect ambience. This is more than just Afternoon Tea, this is an experience.  Tucked inside this prestigious building, Palm Court Restaurant recently underwent a gorgeous refurbishment and features an airy yet chic conservatory-style space. The blend of indstrial metalwork, crystal chandeliers and blooming greenery make this an oasis in which to enjoy Afternoon Tea.  Begin with a selection of traditional finger sandwiches before enjoying an array of scones, which are freshly baked every day and served with clotted cream and a selection of jams. Then, tuck into a decadent selection of cakes and pastries, all washed down with a warming pot of tea.  While Palm Court may feel like a relaxing hideaway, it's only a short drive away from Chester Rail Station.
